query: To transfect pyramidal neurons of vM1 with channelrhodopsin 2 (ChR2), a craniotomy was drilled over the vM1 region (2 mm anterior to bregma and 1.25 mm lateral to the midline) under Isoflurane anesthesia and local anesthetic injection in P25-30 rats.
